WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_cnt
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.tradekind,
    s1.cnt,
    CAST(s1.cnt AS REAL) / s2.total_cnt as proportion
  FROM step1 s1, step2 s2
  WHERE s2.total_cnt IS NOT NULL
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_cnt
  FROM step3
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT 
    s3.tradekind,
    s3.cnt,
    s3.proportion,
    s3.cnt - s4.avg_cnt as excess
  FROM step3 s3, step4 s4
  WHERE s4.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL
    AND s3.cnt > s4.avg_cnt
)
SELECT 
  SUM(cnt) as sum_cnt,
  AVG(proportion) as avg_proportion,
  AVG(excess) as avg_excess
FROM step5
